name: device_info
description: Read the SC9300 workstation identity and firmware version.

name: status
description: Read the controller status register: the command serial number and command code currently executing, whether it completed, and any latched hardware fault such as an opened door, an axis limit, or missing tips.

name: position
description: Read the carriage coordinate (X, Y) and the Z height of one head in millimetres, plus the raw step pulses and both liquid plunger counters.

name: telemetry
description: Read the controller status and the coordinates of every head in one call.

name: check_limit
description: Send a coordinate limit probe. Controller reachability may be unavailable.

name: wait_idle
description: Read status until the controller is idle, reports a fault, or reaches the timeout.

name: stop
description: Request a stop of the running operation.

name: reset
description: Home the carriage and both pipetting heads using the factory reset sequence. Homing moves the full travel; make sure the deck is clear and tips are removed before calling it. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

name: clear_error
description: Clear a latched controller fault after its cause has been removed, for example after closing the door or freeing an axis limit.

name: set_motors
description: Engage or release the servo drives. Release them before moving a head by hand; engage them before any commanded motion.

name: move
description: Move one head to an absolute coordinate in millimetres at the factory motion profile. The controller coordinates X and Y across the carriage and keeps Z per head. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

method.description: lift raises Z before travelling in X and Y; together moves all three axes at once.

name: jog
description: Step one motor by a distance in millimetres from its current position. Use it for manual alignment; use move for absolute positioning. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

direction.description: The motor and direction to step.

name: jaw
description: Clamp or release the gripper jaw to an explicit opening in step pulses. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

name: pick_up_tips
description: Run a tip pickup cycle on one head: travel to the tip box position, descend, seat the tips, and lift. Provide the tip box coordinate and the seat depth. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

zSeat.description: Head Z at which the tips are seated, in millimetres.

zDescent.description: Head Z above the tips before the final descent, in millimetres.

zUp.description: Head Z after seating the tips, in millimetres.

name: set_back_tips
description: Run a tip ejection cycle on one head: travel to the waste position, descend, release the tips into the box, and lift. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

zSeat.description: Head Z at which the tips are released, in millimetres.

zUp.description: Head Z after releasing the tips, in millimetres.

name: aspirate
description: Aspirate a liquid volume with one head at an absolute deck coordinate. The volume is converted to plunger pulses with the factory liquid-compensation table for the mounted pipette size and pipetting mode. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

zBottom.description: Head Z at the vessel bottom, in millimetres.

zDecline.description: Head Z where the tip stops descending, in millimetres. Defaults to the bottom coordinate.

method.description: dive descends to the bottom coordinate; detect stops on the liquid-level sensor.

name: dispense
description: Dispense a liquid volume with one head at an absolute deck coordinate, with an optional blow-out and post-dispense mixing. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

zBottom.description: Head Z at the vessel bottom, in millimetres.

zDecline.description: Head Z where the tip stops descending, in millimetres. Defaults to the bottom coordinate.

blowOut.description: Blow out the residual volume after dispensing.

name: homogenize
description: Mix a liquid in a vessel by repeating aspiration and dispense with one head. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

zBottom.description: Head Z at the vessel bottom, in millimetres.

zDecline.description: Head Z where the tip stops descending, in millimetres. Defaults to the bottom coordinate.

name: clamp_plate
description: Run one gripper plate-handling cycle: travel to the plate, clamp it, move it to the placement coordinate, release it, and lift. Call wait_idle to observe when the controller settles.

zClamp.description: Gripper Z at the clamped plate height, in millimetres.

zApproach.description: Gripper Z above the plate before clamping, in millimetres. Defaults to the clamp height.

zPlace.description: Gripper Z where the plate is released, in millimetres. Defaults to the clamp height.

jawOpening.description: Jaw opening in step pulses used while travelling.

name: set_temperature
description: Hold one heating or cooling module at a target temperature for a bounded duration.

name: oscillate
description: Shake one module at a rotation speed for a bounded duration.

name: temperature_and_oscillate
description: Hold one combined module at a target temperature while shaking it for a bounded duration.

name: magnetic_stand
description: Move one magnetic stand module to a height and hold it there for a bounded duration.

name: set_light
description: Switch the enclosure work light on or off.

name: set_ultraviolet
description: Switch the ultraviolet lamp on or off. An on command carries its own bounded duration.

name: set_filter_fan
description: Switch the HEPA filter fan on or off at a rotation speed.
